subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers resolve this issue through the narrow `heartbeat.session` precedence fix, or fold it into a broader per-session heartbeat/default-DM routing redesign?
rationale: The source-backed bug is narrow and already has an open candidate PR, but the issue text also requests broader default DM/heartbeat isolation that current docs do not promise by default.

options.title: Adopt or replace the narrow fix
options.body: Update, replace, or close the conflicting linked PR with a focused fix that lets configured `heartbeat.session` outrank originating wake sessions and adds regression coverage.

options.title: Fold into broader heartbeat scheduling
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the native per-session heartbeat scheduling direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60275, accepting that the existing bug remains unresolved longer.

options.title: Request fresh live proof first
options.body: Ask reporters for a current live Telegram repro before changing code, even though the current source path still shows the precedence problem.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the narrow fix
recommendation.body: Update, replace, or close the conflicting linked PR with a focused fix that lets configured `heartbeat.session` outrank originating wake sessions and adds regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the adjacent dmScope-main event wake routing PR and is the best available owner for deciding whether to adopt a narrow replacement or require broader product direction.
